obligations.setup: Start from reset or an explicitly predicted queue history; use legal stable binary native inputs.
obligations.stimulus: Assert reset between edges at startup, while occupied and while full; keep write-valid and read-ready high for three reset clocks, release on a falling edge, and send fresh data.
obligations.expected: Before the next rising edge, ready is one and valid is zero. No pre-reset or reset-time write is returned after recovery; fresh writes retain their specified timing and order.
obligations.sampling: Compare ready and valid one time unit after every rising edge, using four-state comparisons; compare data when the independent model predicts valid. Also sample one time unit after each reset assertion before the next rising edge.
